description: This file defines the 'ChatController' class that manages chat sessions, message handling, event processing, and network communication for an Android chat application. It includes methods for sending messages, handling gateway events, managing session states, and parsing JSON responses related to chat history, sessions, and events.

classes.name: ChatController
classes.description: Main class that orchestrates chat session management, message flow, event handling, and network interactions within the Android app.

classes.name: MainSessionState
classes.description: Data class representing the state of the main session key, including current and applied session keys.

classes.name: ChatHistory
classes.description: A data container for parsed chat history information, including messages, session ID, and thinking level.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: Represents an individual chat message with id, role, content, and timestamp.

classes.name: ChatMessageContent
classes.description: Contains the content parts of a chat message, including type, text, mimeType, filename, and base64-encoded content.

classes.name: ChatSessionEntry
classes.description: Represents a chat session entry with key, last updated timestamp, and display name.

classes.name: ChatPendingToolCall
classes.description: Tracks pending tool call events within the chat, including identifiers, args, timestamps, and error states.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a specific chat session by key and initiates bootstrap.

methods.name: applyMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets or updates the main session key, applying session state logic.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Triggers a re-bootstrap of the chat session, fetching latest data.

methods.name: refreshSessions
methods.description: Fetches and updates the list of chat sessions.

methods.name: setThinkingLevel
methods.description: Updates the current thinking level for chat responses.

methods.name: switchSession
methods.description: Switches the current session to another by session key.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message (with optional attachments) within the current chat session.

methods.name: sendMessageAwaitAcceptance
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for confirmation (returns success flag).

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming gateway events like health, chat, agent, tick, and seqGap.

methods.name: parseHistory
methods.description: Parses chat history JSON into internal message/state structures.

methods.name: parseSessions
methods.description: Extracts session entries from JSON response.

methods.name: parseRunId
methods.description: Extracts run ID from response JSON.

methods.name: normalizeThinking
methods.description: Normalizes thinking level input into standardized form.
